title: Contributor Guidelines
text: main — protected. merged via pull request; required checks must green. {issue#}_short-slug — one feature/fix branch per GitHub issue, cut main. issue number prefix ties branch tracker changelog entry. dev branch usage encouraged required deploying complex changes can easier reviewed.

title: Contributor Guidelines
text: Open GitHub issue describing change. Pick appropriate template .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/. Cut branch named {issue#}_short-slug main. j block first, R code makes pass. Every exported function every non-trivial internal helper gets direct unit test. Regenerate documentation format code pushing: Add bullet NEWS.md current development header. Open pull request main.

title: Contributor Guidelines
text: Every issue must covered qcthat: Link test proves issue’s requirement putting issue number test_that() title, e.g. test_that("Transform_Range results must match source data (#32)", ...). qcthat ignores issue numbers comments. Issues need test evidence (documentation, CI, refactoring) get qcthat-nocov label. Obsolete issues closed “planned”. Document test issue order: sample data, preparation functions, compared processing paths, output alignment, expected result. Tests edge cases errors need issue.

title: gsm.ctas cookbook
text: mapping + metrics + reporting workflow layers chain end--end. shared script packaged cookbook Site CTAS Report example stay sync.
code: # End-to-end gsm.ctas pipeline shared by the cookbook and the pkgdown example. # Runs mapping + metrics + reporting workflows against the bundled SDTM # datasets and stops at `lReporting$Reporting_Summary`.  library(workr) library(gsm.mapping) library(gsm.ctas)  lRaw <- list(   Raw_DM      = gsm.ctas::dm,   Raw_LB      = gsm.ctas::lb,   Raw_VS      = gsm.ctas::vs,   Raw_EG      = gsm.ctas::eg,   Raw_RS      = gsm.ctas::rs,   Raw_Queries = gsm.ctas::queries,   Raw_PD      = gsm.ctas::pd )  lMappingWorkflows   <- workr::MakeWorkflowList(strPath = system.file("workflow/1_mappings",  package = "gsm.ctas")) lMetricWorkflows    <- workr::MakeWorkflowList(strPath = system.file("workflow/2_metrics",   package = "gsm.ctas")) lReportingWorkflows <- workr::MakeWorkflowList(strPath = system.file("workflow/3_reporting", package = "gsm.ctas"))  lMapped <- suppressWarnings(suppressMessages(workr::RunWorkflows(   lWorkflows = lMappingWorkflows,   lData = gsm.mapping::Ingest(lRaw, gsm.mapping::CombineSpecs(lMappingWorkflows)) )))  lAnalysis <- suppressWarnings(suppressMessages(workr::RunWorkflows(   lWorkflows = lMetricWorkflows,   lData = lMapped )))  lReporting <- suppressWarnings(suppressMessages(workr::RunWorkflows(   lWorkflows = lReportingWorkflows,   lData = c(lMapped, list(     lAnalyzed = lAnalysis,     lMetricWorkflows = lMetricWorkflows   )) ))) names(lReporting) #> [1] "Reporting_Groups"  "Reporting_Results" "Reporting_Metrics" #> [4] "Reporting_PD"      "Reporting_Queries" "Reporting_Summary"

Must contain study, site, parameter_category_2, parameter_category_3, feature, fdr_corrected_pvalue_logp, timeseries_id. dfSubjects data.frame Standardised subjects studyid, subject_id, site. Used complete (study x site x MetricID) grid sites scored timeseries stay visible. bIncludeMissingness logical Include ratio_missing metric family (parameter_category_3 == "ratio_missing") aggregation.
